items.question: Why did the professor assign this paper instead of just giving you the conclusion?
items.notes: Likely when the student reports only the headline finding without explaining how the method was used.

items.question: How were the earlier-born and later-born cohorts defined in this paper?
items.notes: Likely when the student says ?later cohort? without recalling how the paper split the cohorts.

items.question: Why must you separate cohort difference from age difference in this paper?
pdf_evidence: hulur-et-al-2019 cohort difference versus age difference
items.notes: Likely when the student mixes the research-method lesson with the paper result.

items.question: What is the difference between a higher level of cognitive performance and a slower rate of decline here?
items.notes: Likely when the student says later-born cohorts did better without distinguishing level from trajectory.

items.question: Why does the paper treat cognitive aging as multidimensional rather than one single ability?
items.notes: Likely when the student talks about cognition as one general score.

items.question: What were the three perceived work-environment variables in this paper?
items.notes: Likely when the student remembers the broad idea of job environment but not the actual variables.

items.question: What is the difference between work control and work autonomy in this paper?
pdf_evidence: hulur-et-al-2019 work control versus work autonomy
items.notes: Likely when the student treats the two variables as practically the same.

items.question: Which work-environment variables showed cohort differences, and which one did not?
pdf_evidence: hulur-et-al-2019 cohort differences in work environment
items.notes: Likely when the student says the later-born cohort had a generally better work environment without specifying the pattern.

items.question: Why did the professor bring up the Flynn effect during this discussion?
pdf_evidence: hulur-et-al-2019 cohort differences and Flynn effect context
items.notes: Likely when the student remembers the term but cannot explain why it helps interpret the paper.

items.question: What is the causal-direction problem in this paper?
items.notes: Likely when the student states that enriched work improves cognition as if the paper proved causality.

items.question: What limitation or caution should you mention when explaining this paper?s findings?
items.notes: Likely when the student summarizes the result as if the study were methodologically complete and final.
